name: ReelSpace
description: ReelSpace turns your media library into clear, actionable storage insights. See which movies, shows, libraries, resolutions, codecs, and duplicates consume the most space—then make smarter decisions before your server fills up. Read-only by design.

paths.name: Application data
paths.description: Persistent database, settings, encryption key, and diagnostics.

paths.name: Media
paths.description: Primary media directory. Keep this mapping read-only.

paths.name: Additional shares (optional)
paths.description: Optional Unraid share or /mnt/user mapping for the read-only folder browser. Prefer mapping only the shares you want ReelSpace to see.

paths.name: Downloads (optional)
paths.description: Optional complete or incomplete download directory, read-only.

paths.name: VM storage (optional)
paths.description: Optional domains or VM image directory, read-only.

paths.name: Appdata analysis (optional)
paths.description: Optional appdata directory for analysis only. Never map the application's own /config here.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: Container process user ID. Unraid default is 99 (nobody).

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Container process group ID. Unraid default is 100 (users).

variables.name: UMASK
variables.description: Permissions mask for files created under /config.

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: IANA timezone used for schedules and displayed timestamps.

variables.name: Log level
variables.description: Structured application log verbosity: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, or ERROR.

variables.name: Built-in authentication
variables.description: Enable first-run local administrator setup, Argon2 passwords, expiring sessions, login throttling, and CSRF protection.
